THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Indo-Chinese Chili Chicken

One 21 oz air-fryer batch, split before any seasoning. Kids get 3.5 oz plain per plate with cucumber, garlic bread, and mustard. Adults get 7 oz tossed with charred peppers, onions, and a six-ingredient glaze — no slurry, no simmer, just gloss.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME25 min
COOK METHODAir fryer
EST. / SERVING~400 cal | ~35g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Reserve 7 oz kid chicken BEFORE any seasoning, veg, or sauce touches the wok.

Ingredients

SHARED CHICKEN

  • 21 oz Kirkland Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Chunks (14 oz adult + 7 oz kid)
  • Avocado oil spray (as needed)

ADULT SAUCE (mix all in a glass, no slurry)

  • 1/2 tbsp Kikkoman Thai-Style Chili Sauce
  • 1 tbsp Ching's Red Chili Sauce
  • 1 tbsp Nakano Rice Vinegar
  • 1 tbsp Kikkoman Soy Sauce
  • 1/2 tbsp Sesame Chili Oil
  • 1/2 tbsp Lao Gan Ma Fried Chili in Oil

ADULT VEG

  • 8 oz bell peppers + red onion (large pieces)
  • 1 tbsp Spiceology Jet Tila's Umami Punch (split — 1/2 tbsp on veg, 1/2 tbsp on adult chicken)

Option 1

  • 7 oz reserved plain chicken (creator served 3.5 oz per child; adjust to appetite)
  • Cucumber (sliced into age-appropriate pieces)
  • 2 portions garlic bread (one per child, or adjust)
  • Yellow mustard for dipping

Allergens: soy, gluten, sesame. Check garlic bread for dairy

SPLIT HAPPENS AFTER AIR FRYING, BEFORE ANY SEASONING OR SAUCE. Reserve 7 oz plain chicken for the kids the moment it comes out of the air fryer.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.AIR FRY. All 21 oz chicken at 400°F for 10-12 min (or follow the package). Shake halfway. Goal: crispy and hot through.
  2. 2.RESERVE KID CHICKEN. Set aside 7 oz plain chunks (about 3.5 oz per child) BEFORE any seasoning, veg, or sauce. Everything after this point is adult-only.

Adult — Glossy Chili Chicken (7 oz per plate)

  1. 3.CHAR VEG. Wok on high, light avocado spray. Cook peppers + onions 3-5 min until charred but still crisp.
  2. 4.SEASON VEG. Add 1/2 tbsp Umami Punch to the charred veg. Toss briefly.
  3. 5.ADD ADULT CHICKEN. Add the remaining 14 oz air-fried chicken to the wok. Sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 tbsp Umami Punch.
  4. 6.POUR SAUCE. Pour the prepared six-ingredient sauce over the chicken + veg. No slurry.
  5. 7.TOSS UNTIL GLOSSY. Aggressive toss for 45-75 sec, just until everything is coated and shiny. Kill the heat the second it clings — do NOT simmer.
  6. 8.PLATE ADULTS. 7 oz glossy chili chicken with veg per adult. Serve immediately.

Kid — Plain Chicken + Cucumber + Garlic Bread + Mustard · Option 1

  1. 3.PLATE KIDS. Reserved plain chicken, cucumber slices, warm garlic bread, and a puddle of yellow mustard for dipping. Adjust portions to appetite.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Glossy Chili Chicken (7 oz per plate): Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Plain Chicken + Cucumber + Garlic Bread + Mustard: Portions are what worked for the creator's girls (~3.5 oz chicken per child). Adjust cucumber, bread, and chicken to appetite.

Keys to success

  • High heat the entire adult cook. Low heat = pooled sauce and soft breading.
  • Split the 1 tbsp umami seasoning: half on the veg, half on the adult chicken.

If something fails

Sauce is watery / pooling: Wok isn't hot enough. Keep it ripping and toss briefly until it clings. Don't add slurry by default.

Chicken is soggy / breading fell off: Wok wasn't hot enough, or coated chicken stayed on the heat too long. Toss ≤75 sec and kill the heat.

Too spicy for the adults: Cut the red chili sauce and fried chili in oil by half each. The Thai-style chili sauce carries the sweet-heat backbone.

Vegetables are soft: Larger pieces, very hot wok, short cook (3–5 min max). Char, don't stew.

Kids want more or less: Adjust their plain chicken, cucumber, and bread to appetite. 3.5 oz per child is what worked here, not a rule.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store plain kid chicken and glazed adult chicken in separate containers. Best inside 2 days — the glaze softens the breading over time.

Reheat: Air fryer 375°F for 3-4 min. Avoid microwaving; kills the crisp texture.

Lasts: 1-2 days. Not a meal-prep recipe — it's a same-night winner.

Estimated nutrition

~400 cal | ~35g protein.

Brands I use

Kirkland
Lightly Breaded Chicken Chunks
Air fries crispy, holds up to the wok toss — the shared base
Spiceology
Jet Tila's Umami Punch
1 tbsp total, split half on the veg and half on the adult chicken = umami in two layers, no added liquid
Ching's
Red Chili Sauce
This is what makes the glaze taste Indo-Chinese, not generic Chinese-American
Lao Gan Ma
Fried Chili in Oil
Crunchy chili bits + slow burn — layers into the glaze without diluting it
Kikkoman
Thai-Style Chili Sauce
Sweet-heat backbone of the six-ingredient sauce
Kikkoman
Soy Sauce
Salt + umami depth — the reliable one
Nakano
Rice Vinegar (Seasoned)
Acid + slight sweetness — balances the chili heat
